input.summary: Extend Software/MarketSite.net warranty period to twelve (12) months from acceptance and remove the December 31, 1999 drop-dead cut-off.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from our acceptance of the Software and removed the fixed December 31, 1999 cut-off, since a 60-day period measured from the Effective Date can expire before or shortly after delivery. Our playbook position is 12 months for software; we can accept ninety (90) days from acceptance as a fallback.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1 (the "Warranty Period")
